themes: Digital services growth: 5G expansion, homes acceleration, proprietary technology stack deployed at scale
Domestic market focus: Petrochemicals placement optimization, fuel volume growth (Jio-bp), retail same-day delivery
New energy ecosystem: Vertically integrated solar-battery-generation manufacturing and captive green power
Diversified resilience: Cash generation across cyclical (O2C) and non-cyclical businesses despite macro headwinds
Technology differentiation: AI-enabled factories, heterojunction solar cells, fixed wireless access, sovereign cloud
Industry consolidation: Leveraging global petrochemical capacity rationalization to support margins
risks: Petrochemical oversupply: Global ethylene capacity up 50% vs 3.5% demand growth; margin recovery timeline uncertain
Energy price volatility: Oil down 15%, LNG prices halved from $11 to $9.5; E&P volumes declining from KG D6 natural depletion
Macro uncertainty: FMCG advertiser spend cuts, consumer discretionary weakness, monsoon impact on PVC/PET demand
Geopolitical disruptions: Russian sanctions reducing vessel availability, freight costs elevated, China demand soft
